prereg_findings.finding: the atom wall-recombination term removes (gamma_k/2)(1/4) n_k vbar_k A_wall atoms per second; NP-ICP-CHEM-AIR AIR-WALL-02/03 define gamma as the per-collision recombination probability (O + wall -> 1/2 O2), for which the atom loss is gamma (1/4) n vbar A and the molecule gain half of that. With the [0, 1] physical-bound envelope (IN-18) the literal form cannot reach the physical maximum.
prereg_findings.handling: gamma > 0 in FLOW_BALANCE is withheld as INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (PREREG_FINDING_PF-01_EQ02_ATOM_RECOMBINATION_FACTOR); gamma = 0 is exact under either reading

prereg_findings.finding: background inflow Gamma_bg = (1/4) n_b vbar_b sum A_open carries no transmission probability while effusion carries A_open tau; for tau < 1 the no-plasma, no-feed equilibrium is n = n_b (vbar_b / vbar) / tau instead of the reciprocal n = n_b (same T)
prereg_findings.handling: n_b > 0 with any tau != 1 is withheld as INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (PREREG_FINDING_PF-02_BACKGROUND_INFLOW_WITHOUT_TAU)

prereg_gaps.gap: elastic and vibrational / rotational energy given to neutrals is 'deposited on the walls ... or carried out with outflowing neutrals in proportion to their loss channels', with no operational split (for a non-recombining molecule effusion is the only particle loss channel, which would carry all neutral heating out)
prereg_gaps.handling: Q_icp_plasma_wall_W, the outflow keys, the extraction / radiation keys and the node split are INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (PREREG_GAP_EQ16_NEUTRAL_ENERGY_SPLIT) whenever such a channel is in the set; the solve, I_e_cap and the bias keys are unaffected. Affects every real gas (N2 has elastic, vibrational and rotational channels)

prereg_gaps.handling: partition withheld when dissociation or dissociative ionization is in the set (PREREG_GAP_EQ18_ATOM_FORMATION_ENERGY_DISPOSAL)
